patch_description:
This crossover keeps the stronger lower-tail annealing strategy from the current implementation while adopting barycentric perturbations, mixed edge-seeking restarts, and active-set refinement from the inspiration program.

The principal efficiency improvement is incremental determinant evaluation: moving one of the eight non-vertex points can affect only 45 of the 165 triangle constraints. During annealing, unchanged triangle areas are reused rather than recomputed. This permits a broader deterministic restart schedule and coordinated early exploration without the full-cost evaluation overhead. Final polishing still evaluates all constraints to reliably improve the true maximin objective.
